<!-- en -->
### New
- Message/API-request-level token accounting across AI clients: Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, Codex, WorkBuddy, ZCode, and Zhipu-AutoClaw
- Accurate attribution across dates, models, sessions, forks, and rewind operations
- Codex rollout replay deduplication — rate-limit bucket replays are not double-counted
- CC Switch router attribution backfill (currently effective for the Claude family)
- Two run modes: one-off CLI commands and a real-time monitoring daemon
- Autostart via macOS launchd and the Windows Registry Run key
- In-place self-update from official GitHub Releases (SHA256-verified)
- Single pure-Go binary (no CGO), supporting macOS (Apple Silicon/Intel) and Windows

### Fixed
- CI stability: fixed test cleanup closing arbitrary process file descriptors, which caused intermittent build failures on GitHub Actions runners
- Bilingual (EN/ZH) release notes generation for published releases

<!-- zh -->
### 新功能
- 面向多 AI 客户端（Claude Code/Desktop、OpenCode、Codex、WorkBuddy、ZCode、Zhipu-AutoClaw）的消息/API 请求级 token 记账
- 跨日期、模型、会话、分支与 rewind 操作的精确归属
- Codex rollout 重放去重——速率限制桶变化导致的重放不重复计数
- CC Switch 路由归属回填（当前仅对 Claude 家族生效）
- 两种运行模式：一次性 CLI 命令与实时监控守护进程
- 通过 macOS launchd 与 Windows 注册表 Run 键实现开机自启
- 从官方 GitHub Release 原地自更新（SHA256 校验）
- 纯 Go 单二进制（无 CGO），支持 macOS（Apple 芯片/Intel）与 Windows

### 修复
- CI 稳定性：修复测试清理误关进程内文件描述符导致的 GitHub Actions 偶发构建崩溃
- 发布 Release 的双语（英文/中文）说明生成
